status: HYBRID STRUCTURAL CANDIDATE; CALCULATION SCREENING ONLY; NOT PHYSICALLY QUALIFIED OR NATIVE PCB RELEASE
units: millimetres; Blender coordinates are mm with scale_length 0.001

thread.closingLoadPath: Bezel collar to stationary cup rim; carrier to three independent cup shoulders; moving face and cell are outside this load path

face.returnPads: Three discrete radius 0.7 mm, free 1.1 mm silicone foam pads seated 0.4 mm below carrier stop; rest 1.0 mm / full press 0.4 mm working thickness, force/life pending
face.radioRelief: Local 11.3 x 16.3 relief below skin, upperZ=PCBtop+2.4 radio+0.6 stroke+0.15 clearance; flange interrupted locally at upper radio corner.

capture.complianceCandidate: Rogers BISCO HT-800, nominal 0.79 mm sheet; exact thickness/force must be measured
capture.keeperRetention: A separate stationary carrier post blocks each lateral keeper strip after front face insertion; strips are staged by hand before that
capture.forceCriteria: At 38.44 mm 2 pad area, installed rest preload must remain below 0.9 N (23.4 kPa), and operational force must exceed 1.5 N (39.0 kPa) by measured actuation; no stress-strain/creep test exists.
capture.shoeManufacturing: Purchased/machined metal shoe with separate insulating contact pad; STL is a form gauge, not a resin print part
capture.rigidPlaneStopBound: Four stationary coplanar contacts surround actuator center (-7, -4.5). Positive convex weights bound that rigid-plane point; shoe/support flex, joint slip, contact-height and coplanarity error remain excluded and unqualified.
capture.shoeRearCapture: Central 3.2 x 0.6 mm rear tongue, bottom KZ minus 0.45 mm, and independent keeper edge slots preserve positive rear capture. Roof-limited pitch section is screened separately; actual tolerances, coplanarity and lateral guiding remain unqualified.

privacy.sourceToCad: CAD X=13.5+source Y; CAD Y=-source X
privacy.anchorElectricalIdentity: Unresolved; mechanical copper modeled without assigning grounding
privacy.calibration: Measure T and w per switch. Total external stroke E=T+G-w; replace keeper with channel width 2.2+E (4.1..4.7 mm at stated component bounds). CAD uses 4.4 nominal. Measure electrical endpoint and allowed overtravel before setting stops; nominal model does not establish safe actual endpoint. Internal switch detents only; external grip has 0.7 mm nominal lost motion and no independent detents.

structuralRevision.replaces: M2 checkpoint at main 94 caaf 9; resin 0.30 shoe and 0.50 round carrier arms rejected by stress/deflection screening
structuralRevision.shoeMaterial: Candidate ASTM A666 Type 301 half-hard strip; certified 0.2% yield minimum 110 ksi / 758 MPa; incoming thickness, flatness and edge quality acceptance required
structuralRevision.contactPad: Separate insulating G10/FR4 or equivalent stiff dielectric pad, 1.8 square;0.21 nominal height includes adhesive and must be measured/finished to mounted switch
structuralRevision.stiffenerMaterial: Same certified Type 301 half-hard candidate, 1.00 mm CAD maximum, 0.95 mm minimum for screening; separately cut, deburred and insulated below
structuralRevision.keeperRevision: Two independent 1.1 x 6.4 x 0.6 mm edge strips; no U crossbar across stationary stop arms; each positively blocked after face installation
structuralRevision.rootJoint: Wall-tied cup bed and closure-captured carrier roof clamp steel root; measured packet seating and joint compliance remain unqualified
